subject: Acme Health pilot: credits & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot: Redwood trial credits & budgeting

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — good conversation. A quick recap from our side and one ask as we align internally:

- Use case: automated triage summaries for clinician notes (batch + streaming mix).
- Expected volume: ~1M-1.5M generated tokens/day initially (batch), plus peaks up to ~3M on heavy days.
- Latency needs: most jobs are async; P95 under 2s is ideal for our web UI.

On pricing, the team asked for a quick estimate of unit economics so our finance lead can size the pilot: what should we expect for $/1M generated tokens on the recommended model profile (open LLM quantized) when using Redwood dedicated routing and basic caching?

Also — we'll need a short extension on the trial credits window if possible; our security review delayed setup. Can you confirm how many free credits you can provide and the expiration policy?

Appreciate it — Alex

Alex Johnson
Product Lead, Data Platforms
Acme Health
(415) 555-0198

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Redwood trial credits & budgeting

Hi Alex — great to meet you today. Quick answers + next steps below.

Recap & pricing guidance:
- For the profile we discussed (open-llm quantized, medium context, caching enabled): estimated unit economics are ~ $900-$1,200 per 1M generated tokens (this assumes continuous batching + basic KV prefix caching).
- With expected volume of ~1-1.5M tokens/day, rough monthly spend would be $27k–$45k if you run consistently at that rate.
- Peaks to 3M/day would scale proportionally.
- We can tune model family and quantization to push the $/1M down; I can put together an optimization plan if you want to target $600–$800/1M.

Credits & pilot extension:
- I can offer a one-time trial credit top-up of $10,000 (equivalent for ~8–11M tokens at the above rate) and extend the pilot window by 21 days from the date you finish security onboarding.
- Credits expire 30 days after issuance unless converted into a paid commitment.

Next steps:
1) If that credit amount/expiration works, reply and I’ll route for formal approval.
2) If you want a focused cost-optimization plan, tell me your tolerance for quality trade-offs (safe to move models vs. must preserve top-tier quality).
3) Share expected start date after security sign-off and any procurement contacts.

I’m looping Neha (our AM) to coordinate the paperwork and the credit approval flow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Redwood trial credits & budgeting

Marissa — forwarding Alex’s ask + your proposed credit. Finance/ops check: we can approve a $10k credits top-up on the usual trial terms for Acme Health provided PM confirms start date.

Lukas — can you confirm the accounting code and whether we need a short credit memo? Also attaching a usage export stub so we can justify the extension (Acme_Pilot_Usage_Report_20271004.csv).

Thanks,
Neha

Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Pilot_Usage_Report_20271004.csv

To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Redwood trial credits & budgeting

Neha/Marissa — confirmed. Accounting code SALES_TRIAL_EXT_2027; we can issue a $10,000 credit memo tied to deal ACME-2027-PILOT-47. Finance notes: please capture the approval chain (Marissa -> Neha) in the HubSpot deal before issuing.

I’ll prepare the Pilot_Credits_Terms.pdf (standard trial top-up terms) and link the DocuSign envelope. Plan: credits issued within 24 hours of recorded approval.

Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Redwood trial credits & budgeting

Thanks — all sounds good. Two quick clarifications before we lock in:

1) Can you confirm the $/1M range you quoted assumes both generated + prompt tokens or only generated tokens? Finance cares about total token cost.
2) We’ll take the $10k top-up. Expected start after security completes SSO + network allowlist (targeting 10/18). Could you issue credits to the Acme pilot deal so they appear in the portal?

If you confirm #1 I’ll log the procurement request. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
